verdict.rationale: Better Auth documents built-in social OAuth (Google, GitHub, Apple, Discord), an SSO plugin supporting OIDC/OAuth2/SAML, a JWT plugin with JWKS, and even the Device Authorization Grant (RFC 8628) — all abstracting protocol details behind config/plugins rather than requiring manual implementation. However, the evidence pack never explicitly calls out PKCE handling or refresh-token rotation mechanics for the authorization code flow, so full protocol-detail coverage isn't directly confirmed. missing for 10: explicit PKCE flow documentation, explicit refresh-token lifecycle docs, independent hands-on test of OAuth flow correctness.
